source.text: Hello everyone, today I'm starting a new design task: [Designing a File Storage Solution]. A preliminary selection recommendation report will be provided early next week.

source.text: @Yang Zhao Good question. Regarding the "forgot password" process, our main security consideration is to prevent "user enumeration attacks." Therefore, regardless of whether the email entered by the user exists or not, the feedback message should be consistent, such as "If this email address is registered, you will receive an email containing a password reset link," instead of directly prompting "user does not exist." Please ensure the UI copy adheres to this principle.
